An '''aquarium''' owned by a [[Unidentified countess|countess]] was located on<ref name="LOTJ" /> the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]]<ref name="Traveler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Abregado-rae]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. The [[countess]] ordered a large [[saberfish]] from<ref name="LOTJ" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet<ref name="Traveler's Guide" /> [[Tibrin]] to be placed in the [[aquarium]], having the creature shipped there by [[Captain]] [[Hedda Casset]]'s [[Class A modular freight transport]], ''[[Legacy Run]]''. However, the [[fish]] fell ill in the aquarium as the [[noble]]'s staff proved incapable of caring for it. The [[Gender|woman]] opted to have the creature returned to Tibrin aboard the ''Legacy Run'' instead of letting it [[Death|die]], which Casset later mentally commended her for when thinking about the incident<ref name="LOTJ" /> in [[232 BBY]].<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' to [[232 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The aquarium was mentioned in ''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'', a [[2021]] novel written by [[Charles Soule]]<ref name="LOTJ" /> as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' multimedia project's [[Phase I: Light of the Jedi|Phase I]].<ref name="Phase I">{{HighRepublicReaderGuide}}</ref> A preliminary excerpt of the novel released on [[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]] on [[June 22]], [[2020]] specified that the saberfish received by the aquarium was from<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/read-the-first-chapter-of-star-wars-the-high-republic-light-of-the-jedi-by-charles-soule|text=Read the First Chapter of Star Wars: The High Republic - Light of the Jedi by Charles Soule|author=[https://www.ign.com/person/JoshuaYehl-IGN Joshua Yehl]|date=2020-06-22|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20200622161235}}</ref> the Core Worlds planet<ref name="SW29">[[Star Wars (2020) 29|''Star Wars'' (2020) 29]]</ref> [[Spira]];<ref name="IGN" /> however, in the final version, this was changed to Tibrin.<ref name="LOTJ" />
